name: nexus-desktop
description: Local Nexus planning, bounded reference research, capability routing, server-issued short-lived Host inventory tickets, and Host-owned execution handoff for ChatGPT Desktop and Codex.

interface.longDescription: Nexus plans and routes substantive work, using bounded Default Reference Research where appropriate. It can assess only a current-turn subset of metadata already surfaced by ChatGPT Desktop, not private Host state. Its local MCP server never publishes remotely, expands privilege, executes a plan, mutates an artifact, or validates an outcome; the ChatGPT Host retains those authorities.
defaultPrompt: Use Nexus to create an editable PowerPoint presentation.
Use Nexus to plan a backend bug fix with regression tests.
Use Nexus to plan a new website with bounded reference research before implementation.
